create.name: Chandra Easton
create.bio:
Chandra Easton is a teacher of Tibetan Buddhism based in the San Francisco Bay Area. She studied Tibetan language in Dharamsala in 1996, then religious studies at the University of California, Santa Barbara, where she worked with B. Alan Wallace on an English translation of two Dzogchen texts. Since 1999 she has trained with Lama Tsultrim Allione, and in 2015 she was named a Dorje Lopön, or vajra teacher, of Tara Mandala, where she helps shape the study programmes. Her 2023 book Embodying Tara explores the twenty-one forms of the female Buddha Tara as a living practice for today.

Her classes join seated meditation, mantra, devotional singing, gentle yoga and talks on the Dharma, and she has taught Hatha Yoga alongside Buddhism since 2001, later adding Tibetan yogic exercises. She leads a weekly online class, Releasing Into Presence, as well as weekend retreats in Berkeley and long-running annual programmes at Esalen in Big Sur. With two fellow singers she founded the 21 Taras Collective, which sets the Tara mantras to music. She also offers one-to-one guidance, including sessions in the Feeding Your Demons method developed by her teacher.

books.title: Embodying Tara: Twenty-One Manifestations to Awaken Your Innate Wisdom
books.author: Chandra Easton
books.description: A guide to the twenty-one forms of Tara, the female Buddha of Tibetan tradition, published by Shambhala in 2023. Each chapter introduces one form with its story, mantra and a practice, drawing on scholarship and the author's own years of devotion.

courses.title: Wintering Within: Meditation, Music, and Gentle Yoga for the New Year
courses.description: A New Year week at Esalen in Big Sur built around winter as a season for slowing down. Days hold calm-abiding meditation indoors and by the ocean, mantra and gentle yoga, with live music from the duo Sorelia.

courses.title: Rewilding Consciousness: Embodied Wisdom and the Ecology of Awakening
courses.description: A five-day Esalen workshop co-led with Tenzin Seldon that pairs meditation on the five elements, mantra and breathing practice with group inquiry into regeneration. Much of the practice takes place outdoors on the land, ending each day with devotional music.

courses.title: Deepening Into Presence: A Weekend of Meditation, Mantra & Movement
courses.description: A residential weekend at Anza Retreat in the Berkeley hills that takes the themes of her weekly class further. Sessions combine meditation on the elements, chanting, gentle movement and Dharma talks, with a Saturday evening of live devotional music; meals and lodging are included.

courses.title: Releasing Into Presence
courses.description: A weekly one-hour class on Zoom mixing Buddhist and Hindu stories, meditation, mantra, breathing and gentle movement. Drop-ins pay what they can within a sliding scale, and subscribers also get the recordings.

courses.title: One-to-One Sessions with Lopön Chandra
courses.description: Private meetings booked online, either for general guidance on meditation practice or as a guided Feeding Your Demons session. A short free introductory call is also offered.

free_resources.title: Meditation Audio Teachings
free_resources.description: Two guided recordings to stream from her website: a calm-abiding (shamatha) meditation and a gratitude practice.

free_resources.title: Embodying Tara Resources
free_resources.description: Companion pages to her book, one for each of the twenty-one forms of Tara, to support readers who are working through the practices.

free_resources.title: Courageous Heart
free_resources.description: A free three-part video introduction to Tara practice, presented by Lion's Roar. Sign-up with an email address is needed to watch.
